item.title: How the B-1B Lancer Bomber Came Back from the Dead
item.description: The B-1 Lancer program was curtailed in the 1970s as an unnecessary waste of taxpayer dollars. That changed when Ronald Reagan entered office. The post How the B-1B Lancer Bomber Came Back from the Dead appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The OA-1K Skyraider II Has Something Very Strange on Its Nose
item.description: The Skyraider II is the first US Air Force plane since the Vietnam War to have a propeller instead of a jet engine—but there are good reasons for it. The post The OA-1K Skyraider II Has Something Very Strange on Its Nose appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Where Are America’s Aircraft Carriers Now?
item.description: Although the US Navy has 11 nuclear-powered aircraft carriers in active service, only around half are deployed at any given time—with the rest in port or undergoing maintenance. The post Where Are America’s Aircraft Carriers Now? appeared first on The National Interest.
